info.name: Fence OpenAPI Specification admin/user register API
Register in order to get access to download data

items.docs: This register functionality enables a registration page for users to provide basic information before being added to a preconfigured group. The GET request will redirect to a HTML page where users can provide their first name, last name, organization, and email, in order to gain some predefined permissions (i.e. to be automatically added to a preconfigured Arborist group).
